# GitHub Actions Output Formatter

## Context

Bivvy runs in CI environments but currently outputs plain text via `NonInteractiveUI`. GitHub Actions supports workflow command annotations (`::error::`, `::warning::`, `::notice::`, `::group::`) that display inline in PR diffs and the Actions summary. Adding a dedicated `GitHubActionsUI` implementation will surface errors and warnings as first-class annotations with zero configuration.

## Approach

New `UserInterface` implementation (`GitHubActionsUI`) following the existing pattern of `TerminalUI` / `NonInteractiveUI` / `MockUI`. Auto-detects via `GITHUB_ACTIONS` env var, with explicit `--github-actions` CLI flag for opt-in/testing.

### Method-to-annotation mapping

| `UserInterface` method | GitHub Actions output |
|---|---|
| `error(msg)` | `::error::{msg}` |
| `warning(msg)` | `::warning::{msg}` |
| `success(msg)` | `::notice::{msg}` |
| `message(msg)` | plain `println!` |
| `show_header(title)` | `::group::{title}` |
| `show_run_header(...)` | `::group::Bivvy: {app_name} v{version} · {workflow}` |
| `show_run_summary(...)` | step listing + `::endgroup::` (+ `::error::` on failure) |
| `show_error_block(cmd, out, hint)` | `::error::Command failed: {cmd}\n{output}` |
| `show_hint(hint)` | `::notice::{hint}` |
| `show_workflow_progress(...)` | suppressed (noisy in logs) |
| `start_spinner(msg)` | plain print; spinner finish uses annotations |
| `prompt(...)` | same as `NonInteractiveUI` (env overrides → defaults → error) |

Newlines in annotation messages escaped as `%0A`, `%` as `%25`, `\r` as `%0D`.

## Steps

### 1. Add `is_github_actions()` platform detection

**Files:** `src/shell/platform.rs`, `src/shell/mod.rs`

- Add `pub fn is_github_actions() -> bool` next to `is_ci()`
- Re-export from `src/shell/mod.rs`
- Unit test alongside existing `is_ci_detects_environment`

### 2. Create `src/ui/github_actions.rs` with full `UserInterface` impl

**Files:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (new), `src/ui/mod.rs`

- `GitHubActionsUI` struct with `OutputMode`, `Box<dyn Write>` writer, `HashMap<String, String>` env overrides
- `new(mode)` → stdout writer; `#[cfg(test)] with_writer(w, mode)` for testable output capture
- `escape_annotation(msg) -> String` helper
- `GitHubActionsSpinner` implementing `SpinnerHandle` (finish_success → `::notice::`, finish_error → `::error::`, finish_skipped → plain)
- Register module in `src/ui/mod.rs`: `pub mod github_actions;` + `pub use github_actions::GitHubActionsUI;`
- Unit tests: error/warning/success annotations, message plain text, group commands, silent mode suppression, escape function, prompt handling

### 3. Add `--github-actions` CLI flag and wire into `main.rs`

**Files:** `src/cli/args.rs`, `src/main.rs`

- Add `#[arg(long, global = true)] pub github_actions: bool` to `Cli` struct
- In `main.rs`: `let use_gha = cli.github_actions || is_github_actions();` → select `GitHubActionsUI` or existing `create_ui()`
- CLI parsing tests for the flag

### 4. Integration tests

**Files:** `tests/cli_test.rs`

- Test `--github-actions` flag emits `::notice::` / `::group::` on success
- Test `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` env auto-detection
- Test error path emits `::error::`

### 5. Documentation

**Files:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (rustdoc), `src/ui/README.md`

- Rustdoc on all public items with link to GitHub Actions docs
- Update `src/ui/README.md` with GHA output section and mapping table

### 6. Verification

```
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --all-features
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo check --all-targets --all-features
cargo build --release
```

## Commit plan

1. "Add is_github_actions platform detection" — `src/shell/platform.rs`, `src/shell/mod.rs`
2. "Add GitHubActionsUI with workflow command annotations" — `src/ui/github_actions.rs`, `src/ui/mod.rs`
3. "Wire GitHubActionsUI into CLI with --github-actions flag" — `src/cli/args.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `tests/cli_test.rs`
4. "Document GitHub Actions output formatter" — rustdoc, `src/ui/README.md`

# GitHub Actions Output Formatter

## Context

Bivvy runs in CI environments but currently outputs plain text via `NonInteractiveUI`. GitHub Actions supports workflow command annotations (`::error::`, `::warning::`, `::notice::`, `::group::`) that display inline in PR diffs and the Actions summary. Adding a dedicated `GitHubActionsUI` implementation will surface errors and warnings as first-class annotations with zero configuration.

## Approach

New `UserInterface` implementation (`GitHubActionsUI`) following the existing pattern of `TerminalUI` / `NonInteractiveUI` / `MockUI`. Auto-detects via `GITHUB_ACTIONS` env var, with explicit `--github-actions` CLI flag for opt-in/testing.

### Method-to-annotation mapping

| `UserInterface` method | GitHub Actions output |
|---|---|
| `error(msg)` | `::error::{msg}` |
| `warning(msg)` | `::warning::{msg}` |
| `success(msg)` | `::notice::{msg}` |
| `message(msg)` | plain `println!` |
| `show_header(title)` | `::group::{title}` |
| `show_run_header(...)` | `::group::Bivvy: {app_name} v{version} · {workflow}` |
| `show_run_summary(...)` | step listing + `::endgroup::` (+ `::error::` on failure) |
| `show_error_block(cmd, out, hint)` | `::error::Command failed: {cmd}\n{output}` |
| `show_hint(hint)` | `::notice::{hint}` |
| `show_workflow_progress(...)` | suppressed (noisy in logs) |
| `start_spinner(msg)` | plain print; spinner finish uses annotations |
| `prompt(...)` | same as `NonInteractiveUI` (env overrides → defaults → error) |

Newlines in annotation messages escaped as `%0A`, `%` as `%25`, `\r` as `%0D`.

## Steps

### 1. Add `is_github_actions()` platform detection

**Files:** `src/shell/platform.rs`, `src/shell/mod.rs`

- Add `pub fn is_github_actions() -> bool` next to `is_ci()`
- Re-export from `src/shell/mod.rs`
- Unit test alongside existing `is_ci_detects_environment`

### 2. Create `src/ui/github_actions.rs` with full `UserInterface` impl

**Files:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (new), `src/ui/mod.rs`

- `GitHubActionsUI` struct with `OutputMode`, `Box<dyn Write>` writer, `HashMap<String, String>` env overrides
- `new(mode)` → stdout writer; `#[cfg(test)] with_writer(w, mode)` for testable output capture
- `escape_annotation(msg) -> String` helper
- `GitHubActionsSpinner` implementing `SpinnerHandle` (finish_success → `::notice::`, finish_error → `::error::`, finish_skipped → plain)
- Register module in `src/ui/mod.rs`: `pub mod github_actions;` + `pub use github_actions::GitHubActionsUI;`
- Unit tests: error/warning/success annotations, message plain text, group commands, silent mode suppression, escape function, prompt handling

### 3. Add `--github-actions` CLI flag and wire into `main.rs`

**Files:** `src/cli/args.rs`, `src/main.rs`

- Add `#[arg(long, global = true)] pub github_actions: bool` to `Cli` struct
- In `main.rs`: `let use_gha = cli.github_actions || is_github_actions();` → select `GitHubActionsUI` or existing `create_ui()`
- CLI parsing tests for the flag

### 4. Integration tests

**Files:** `tests/cli_test.rs`

- Test `--github-actions` flag emits `::notice::` / `::group::` on success
- Test `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` env auto-detection
- Test error path emits `::error::`

### 5. Documentation

**Files:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (rustdoc), `src/ui/README.md`

- Rustdoc on all public items with link to GitHub Actions docs
- Update `src/ui/README.md` with GHA output section and mapping table

### 6. Verification

```
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --all-features
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo check --all-targets --all-features
cargo build --release
```

## Commit plan

1. "Add is_github_actions platform detection" — `src/shell/platform.rs`, `src/shell/mod.rs`
2. "Add GitHubActionsUI with workflow command annotations" — `src/ui/github_actions.rs`, `src/ui/mod.rs`
3. "Wire GitHubActionsUI into CLI with --github-actions flag" — `src/cli/args.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `tests/cli_test.rs`
4. "Document GitHub Actions output formatter" — rustdoc, `src/ui/README.md`
